fn main() {
    let list = push(vec(), 1)
    let index = 5
    print(get(&list, index))
}

fn push(mutNsV: Vec<Int>, x: Int) -> Vec<Int> {
    v = push(v, x)
    drop v
    v
}

fn get(v: &Vec<Int>, i: Int) -> Option<Int> {
    if i < 0 || i >= len(&v) {
        None
    } else {
        Some(v.get(i))
    }
}

fn len(v: &Vec<Int>) -> Int {
    v.len()
}

fn print(x: Option<Int>) {
    if letSome(x) == x {
        print_str(x.to_str())
    }
}

fn print_str(s: Str) {
    std_print(s)
}

fn std_print(s: Str) {
    drop s
    s
}

fn drop_main(x: Vec<Int>) {
    drop x
}

fn drop_list(v: Vec<Int>) {
    drop v
}

fn drop_index(i: Int) {
    drop i
}

fn drop_option(x: Option<Int>) {
    drop x
}

fn drop_str(s: Str) {
    drop s
}

fn drop_std_print(s: Str) {
    drop s
}

fn clone_main(x: Vec<Int>) -> Vec<Int> {
    x
}

fn clone_list(v: Vec<Int>) -> Vec<Int> {
    v
}

fn clone_index(i: Int) -> Int {
    i
}

fn clone_option(x: Option<Int>) -> Option<Int> {
    x
}

fn clone_str(s: Str) -> Str {
    s
}

fn clone_std_print(s: Str) -> Str {
    s
}

fn range(a: Int, b: Int) -> Vec<Int> {
    push(push(vec(), a), b - 1)
}

fn str_len(s: Str) -> Int {
    s.len()
}

fn concat(a: Str, b: Str) -> Str {
    a + b
}

fn chars(s: Str) -> Vec<Str> {
    let mut result = vec()
    for c in s.chars() {
        result = push(result, c)
    }
    drop s
    result
}

fn int_to_str(n: Int) -> Str {
    n.to_str()
}

fn parse_int(s: Str) -> Option<Int> {
    s.parse_int()
}

fn to_float(n: Int) -> Float {
    n.to_float()
}

fn trunc(x: Float) -> Int {
    x.trunc()
}

fn assert_eq(a: Int, b: Int) {
    if a != b {
        print_str("Assertion failed: ".to_str())
        print_str(a.to_str())
        print_str(" != ".to_str())
        print_str(b.to_str())
        print_str("\n".to_str())
        drop a
        drop b
        drop_main(vec())
        std_exit(1)
    }
}

fn assert_eq_option(a: Option<Int>, b: Option<Int>) {
    if a != b {
        print_str("Assertion failed: ".to_str())
        print_str(a.to_str())
        print_str(" != ".to_str())
        print_str(b.to_str())
        print_str("\n".to_str())
        drop a
        drop b
        drop_main(vec())
        std_exit(1)
    }
}

fn assert_eq_str(a: Str, b: Str) {
    if a != b {
        print_str("Assertion failed: ".to_str())
        print_str(a)
        print_str(" != ".to_str())
        print_str(b)
        print_str("\n".to_str())
        drop a
        drop b
        drop_main(vec())
        std_exit(1)
    }
}

fn assert_eq_str_option(a: Option<Str>, b: Option<Str>) {
    if a != b {
        print_str("Assertion failed: ".to_str())
        print_str(a.to_str())
        print_str(" != ".to_str())
        print_str(b.to_str())
        print_str("\n".to_str())
        drop a
        drop b
        drop_main(vec())
        std_exit(1)
    }
}

fn main_test() {
    let list = push(vec(), 1)
    let index = 0
    assert_eq(get(&list, index), Some(1))
    let index = 1
    assert_eq(get(&list, index), None)
}
